b: Once we make it through today, we’ll already be 20% of the way through this month’s challenge. How is that even possible?

For today’s prompt, write a power poem. There are a lot of powerful possibilities for this prompt. Of course, there’s electric power, gas power, water power, solar power, and all the other energetic powers out there. But there’s also the power of love and the power of Castle Grayskull (on the planet of Eternia). There are power dynamics, super powers, flower power, Austin Powers, and many other powerful interpretations. Flex your poetic powers today.
Remember: These prompts are springboards to creativity. Use them to expand your possibilities, not limit them.

Here’s my attempt at a Power Poem:

I’ll be ready
in a moment
but forgot to
recharge my phone
which I left unplugged
and is now
low on power
and nearly dead
Forgive me
I was searching
the icebox
for some plums
(Note on today’s poem: Inspired by WCW’s “This Is Just To Say.”)
